On a news website, Instructor wants Navigator to open a specific tab on the page, i.e., "Sportsday on 28 May 2023 at 4.15 AM". S2: Instructor requests the location on a food delivery website to be set to Las Vegas, Nevada. The Delivery Details page is already open. GPT-4V (R) clicks on an incorrect (3:30AM) tab. GPT-4V (R) attempts to exit the Delivery details page and reopen it, which could lead to a loop. LLaMA (B) clicks on the correct 4:15AM tab.
